picks.title: Wonder Interactive's Strata uses AI to take Unreal Engine games to browsers using WebAssembly and WebGPU
picks.excerpt: Wonder Interactive has unveiled Strata, an AI-powered dev tool that that can turn Unreal Engine projects into playable browser links using WebAssembly and WebGPU.
picks.rationale: New dev tool release: AI-assisted pipeline that turns Unreal Engine projects into shareable browser builds via WebAssembly/WebGPU — directly actionable for devs.

picks.title: Epic wants to pay you $50,000 to vibe code an AI slop game
picks.excerpt: Epic Games' Unreal Engine AI MegaJam promises up to $50,000 in prizes for games built with AI tools ('Vibe your way to 50K'), drawing backlash over Epic's AI-first push.
picks.rationale: New announcement: Epic launches the Unreal Engine AI MegaJam with up to $50K in prizes for AI-built games — a concrete program, not more commentary on the AI-first memo.

picks.title: Someone hacked the Switch 2 by using an old game and AI
picks.excerpt: The Nintendo Switch 2 has apparently been jailbroken by a modder who used OpenAI tools and the $25 SmileBASIC 4 eShop app, already showing a custom Mario Kart World with new playable characters.
picks.rationale: New event: an AI-assisted Switch 2 jailbreak via a $25 eShop app — a first for AI-driven console exploitation with platform-security implications.

picks.title: Machinarium AI tribute cops a flogging from studio: 'This looks disgusting'
picks.excerpt: Amanita Design condemned an AI-generated 'tribute' to Machinarium posted by the CEO of AI storytelling company Nura Studios, saying it 'looks disgusting and has nothing to do with us or our craft'.
picks.rationale: New incident: Amanita Design publicly disowns an AI-generated Machinarium 'tribute' by an AI studio CEO — art-style appropriation, relevant to artists and IP holders.

picks.title: "Someone's getting fired": Arc Raiders player says Embark used ChatGPT to respond to their complaint and accidentally sent several messages intended for others
picks.excerpt: An Arc Raiders player says Embark Studios support used ChatGPT to answer their complaint, accidentally pasting a chain of about 10 prompt-and-response exchanges including messages meant for other players.
picks.rationale: New incident: Embark's player support pasted a ChatGPT prompt chain including other players' messages — a cautionary case for AI in live-ops customer support.
